integrity: Full analytical argument and separately reproducible finite numerical checks included; cited rank-one criterion and Euler product are prior tools, not newly claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact two-ray and counting laws hold for one explicitly chosen compact weighted shift and square-zero rank-one functional at fixed q and nonzero coupling. There is no uniformity as q approaches 1, no finite-index classification, and no independent audit.
title: A two-ray geometric eigenvalue law for a nilpotent rank-one perturbation of a compact quasinilpotent shift
